title: QA run · studio-authoring (15/20) · ba4afcc2 · 2026-10-19 · 13 PASS / 1 PARTIAL / 1 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 5 NOT-RUN
body:
Round 2 of the 18.0 release sweep for `studio-authoring`: re-judges on `ba4afcc2` the clauses round 1 (#24571, subject `5b14b7f3`) left unjudged and that this environment can drive (A class); every other verdict is carried forward from #24571 below. Supersedes #24571 under checklist-test SKILL §5. Wave anchor: #24579.

## Environment fingerprint
- framework `ba4afcc2391922a86678bf5e47b1a0e4d2c87ff1` (pinned; one commit after round 1's `5b14b7f3`, a release-script fix — `git diff 5b14b7f3 ba4afcc2 -- docs/qa/platform-checklist/` is empty, so every item revision is unchanged and carried verdicts stay revision-valid)
- console `.objectui-sha` `4016370af3c9c9dafec2bc5299afd8e8079701b8`, built with `pnpm objectui:build` (deps `--concurrency=2`); `packages/console/dist/.objectui-sha` stamp equals the pin
- app: showcase, canonical boot `OS_PORT=PORT pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:/tmp/qa2/LABEL/ITEM.db`; own port + file DB per runner/item; scratch app copies for metadata-writing items; seed `--seed-admin` + showcase seed
- browser: Playwright, `executablePath /opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, one context per runner, form sign-in
- timestamps 2026-10-19: environment prep 14:12–14:44 UTC (cold tree: install 39 s, `pnpm build` 10m20s, console build ~25 min); testing 14:44–15:05 UTC (+ rule-7 verifier 15:10–15:18 UTC)
- execution: one browser runner sub-agent (one Playwright context) on :47551, booted from a scratch copy of the showcase with a writable scratch package `com.example.qa-sa`; an independent rule-7 verifier re-derived expression-editors negative[0] server-side on :47591

## Scope
- selector `studio-authoring` — 20 items (resolver-runnable set; planned/blocked items as in #24571). Revisions per item are those recorded in #24571 (unchanged at ba4afcc2).
- Re-judged this round (A class):

  - `studio-authoring.record-page-roundtrip` — acceptance[3] (on showcase_contact per #24579 §3)

## Reproduction rules (fails)
### studio-authoring.expression-editors · N0 — RLS editor lints a non-lowerable USING as a WARNING; build/publish gate refuses it as an ERROR
1. Boot showcase (any port), sign in admin; POST /api/v1/packages {"manifest":{"id":"com.example.qa-sa","name":"QA","version":"0.1.0","type":"app"}}; author any object in it (e.g. qa_sa_repair_asset with a text field asset_code) and a permission set qa_sa_matrix (PUT …/meta/permission/qa_sa_matrix?mode=draft&package=com.example.qa-sa, publish).
2. Open /_console/studio/com.example.qa-sa/access?surface=permission%3Aqa_sa_matrix → Row-level security → Add policy; name qa_rls_probe, object qa_sa_repair_asset, USING `size(record.asset_code) > 3` (typed).
3. Expected (N0 parity with build): the editor's tier equals the build/author-time verdict. Actual: editor shows WARNING "This read filter isn't a simple field comparison (unsupported operand "call") … can be dropped and WIDEN access" and autosaves (PUT …?mode=draft 200).
4. POST /api/v1/meta/permission/qa_sa_matrix/publish?package=com.example.qa-sa → 422 INVALID_METADATA, rule `rls-predicate-unenforceable`, severity error: "RLS using is not lowerable (unsupported operand "call"), so the policy is dropped and grants no access" (packages/lint/src/validate-rls-predicate-enforceability.ts — same rule `os build` runs).
5. Source check at objectui 4016370a: packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/celAuthoring.ts lintCelPredicate pushes `severity: 'warning'` / `engine.celLint.notPushdownable` for `isPushdownableCel(...).ok === false` — so the bundle is not stale; the editor's tier and its fail-OPEN wording contradict the framework's fail-CLOSED, error-tier gate.
Note: acceptance[2]/[4] of this item themselves prescribe "non-pushdownable USING = WARNING, Save stays enabled", so the item is internally inconsistent with N0 since #4983's gate — the maintainer must rule which side moves (objectui editor to error tier / fail-closed copy, or the checklist clauses).

## Product defects (extraction)
- expression-editors negative[0] `fail` → disposition **product defect** in objectui (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/celAuthoring.ts` `lintCelPredicate` gives a non-lowerable RLS predicate `severity: 'warning'` with "may … WIDEN access" wording, where the engine rule `rls-predicate-unenforceable` is an error and fails closed): extracted — see the Extracted: line in the close-out comment. The item's own acceptance[2]/[4] encode the editor's warning tier (checklist-accuracy finding below).
- objectui (celAuthoring.ts lintCelPredicate) — non-lowerable RLS USING linted as advisory warning with fail-OPEN copy while the framework author-time gate refuses it as error and documents runtime fail-CLOSED (see Repro rule). Authors get "Saved" on a policy that can never publish.
- Cosmetic (objectui, already noted round 1): after a held CEL error the object designer pill reads "Auto-saving…" indefinitely while nothing is sent.

## Checklist-accuracy findings / fixture gaps
For the wave anchor #24579 (not extracted).
- metadata-diagnostics-sweep: knownGaps[0] ("invalid stored row unplantable in-run") is too strong — on a scratch file DB the row is plantable: save a valid view through the door, then rewrite `sys_metadata.metadata` for that id with better-sqlite3 (e.g. config.columns[0].field = 123); the next sweep reports it (no restart needed). To exercise the directory badge it must be saved WITH `?package=WRITABLE-PKG` (DirectoryPage is always package-scoped, so an env-wide/package-less row never reaches a tile badge or the red button). Also: the located entry carries rootless union parents (`path:""` / `config.columns` "Invalid input") alongside the located leaf — fine under acceptance[6]'s wording, worth stating.
- metadata-diagnostics-sweep step 6: the directory always repairs `?package=` to a project package, so "the red diagnostics-link button" can only be judged per package scope.
- record-page-roundtrip acceptance[3]: besides showcase_invoice's shipped default, no stock non-admin persona can read showcase_contact (auditor.demo → "You don't have access to Contact records"); "as an end user" needs a grant fixture or should say admin. The anchor's showcase_contact substitution works. Also: a `record:highlights` block without `fields` passes the draft PUT (200) but fails publish 422 component-props-invalid.
- draft-publish-lifecycle A6/step 2: the chip text at the pin reads "Draft · N unpublished" (and "Design · includes unpublished changes"), not "Unpublished draft". A publish done out-of-band (REST) is reflected in Studio only after reload — fine, but say so. Rollback POST refuses `?package=` (400 "not supported … Supported parameters: member, toVersion"); package-scoped draft DELETE is `?state=draft` (not `?mode=draft`). A scratch dashboard in a namespaced package needs the NS_ prefix (used qa_sa_lifecycle_probe).
- expression-editors: validate_expression has no RLS/USING site (formula|validation|flow_condition|template), so the A6 parity table cannot ground the RLS pushdown probe on it — the engine truth there is the lint rule rls-predicate-unenforceable (error), which conflicts with acceptance[2]/[4] (see Repro rule). In the Studio package door there is no Save button (autosave); the gate is the `perm-autosave-held` status "Fix the CEL syntax errors before saving." — acceptance[4]'s "disables Save (title perm.cel.saveBlocked)" applies only to the env door, unreachable on stock (no writable env-scope permission set).
- object-designer-roundtrip: designer autosaves after the first save (Save button then has no title/disabled), so step 5's "Save draft" is implicit; field reorder is native HTML5 DnD (Playwright `dragTo` works, mouse moves don't).
- permission-matrix-editor-ux: Studio Access shows only the package's own objects ("0 objects granted" even when the set grants showcase_account), so the > 6-field object must be a package object or the env door must be used; filter "owner" matches only owner_id (Owning Business Unit is not matched). Headless chromium paints no scrollbars (overlay), so acceptance[4]'s "screenshot shows a horizontal scrollbar" needs the scrollWidth/scroll evidence instead.
- **studio-authoring.expression-editors acceptance[2] / acceptance[4] contradict negative[0] and acceptance[6]:** both require a non-pushdownable USING predicate to be a WARNING with Save enabled and fail-open framing, while the engine rules it an ERROR (ADR-0056 D4 / #4983; `packages/lint/src/validate-rls-predicate-enforceability.ts`) and the runtime fails closed. Re-point both to the error tier and fail-closed semantics; this round scored acceptance[4] "pass (as written)".
